Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Emerging technologies are changing the way we live and work. (i) Define emerging technologies. (ii) Explain Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things and Quantum Computing with one example or use each. (8 marks)
(Emerging technologies hamare jeene aur kaam ka andaz badal rahi hain. (i) Emerging technologies ki definition likhein. (ii) Artificial Intelligence, Internet of Things aur Quantum Computing ko aik aik misal ya istemal ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Definition: Emerging technologies (ubharti hui technologies) woh naye tools, systems aur tareeqe hain jo abhi ban rahe hain ya jin ka istemal abhi shuru hua hai. Yeh hamare jeene, kaam karne aur duniya se raabte ka andaz badal sakti hain.

(ii) 1. Artificial Intelligence (AI): AI woh machines aur software hain jo insanon ki tarah soch aur seekh sakte hain. Yeh chehre pehchanne, bol samajhne aur faisle karne mein madad karti hai. Misal: Siri jaise smart assistants se le kar khud chalne wali gaariyon tak.

2. Internet of Things (IoT): IoT rozmarra ki cheezon, jaise fridge, gaariyon aur kapron, ko internet se jorta hai taake woh data bhej aur le sakein; is se zindagi aasan hoti hai. Misal: smart thermostat aap ka schedule seekh kar ghar ka temperature khud set karta hai.

3. Quantum Computing: Quantum computers quantum physics ke usoolon se information ko aam computers se bohat tez process karte hain. Yeh aise intehai mushkil masail hal kar sakte hain jo abhi aam computers ke liye na-mumkin hain.

book_ref.quote: Here are some of the key emerging technologies

blocks.prompt:
2 Explain the following emerging technologies, giving the use or example of each from the book: Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality, 5G Technology and Biotechnology. (8 marks)
(Neeche di gayi emerging technologies ko kitab ke istemal ya misal ke saath samjhayein: Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality, 5G Technology aur Biotechnology.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Augmented Reality (AR): AR smartphones ya glasses ke zariye asal duniya mein digital cheezein jorti hai. Yeh gaming, taleem aur training mein istemal hoti hai.

2. Virtual Reality (VR): VR aik mukammal virtual mahol banati hai jis se khaas saman ke zariye raabta kiya jata hai. AR ki tarah yeh bhi gaming, taleem aur training mein istemal hoti hai.

3. 5G Technology: 5G wireless technology ki agli nasal hai jo bohat tez internet aur zyada qabil-e-aitbar connection deti hai. Is se mobile phones, smart devices aur AR/VR jaisi nayi technologies behtar chalengi.

4. Biotechnology: Biotechnology mein zinda ajsam, jaise bacteria aur plants, se nayi cheezein banai ya masail hal kiye jate hain. Misal: scientists is se nayi dawaiyan, behtar faslein aur mahol dost materials bana rahe hain.

book_ref.quote: These technologies are used in gaming, education, and training

blocks.prompt:
3 Cloud computing rests on a few basic concepts. (i) Define cloud computing. (ii) Explain virtualization, scalability with elasticity, and on-demand access, giving the book's example of each. (8 marks)
(Cloud computing chand bunyadi concepts par khari hai. (i) Cloud computing ki definition likhein. (ii) Virtualization, scalability aur elasticity, aur on-demand access ko kitab ki misalon ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Definition: Cloud computing aik model hai jo internet ke zariye servers, storage aur applications jaise computing resources tak aasan rasai deta hai. Yeh resources kam se kam intizami mehnat ya provider se raabte ke saath jaldi diye aur wapas liye ja sakte hain. Aap sirf istemal ka paisa dete hain; yeh aisa hai jaise supercomputer kiraye par lena jo duniya mein kahin se bhi jab chahein istemal ho.

(ii) 1. Virtualization: aisi technology jo aik physical machine par kai virtual machines chalati hai. Har virtual computer apna operating system aur applications aise chalata hai jaise alag machine ho. Is se hardware ka behtar istemal, kam kharch aur aasan management hoti hai: aik computer kai ban jata hai.

2. Scalability aur elasticity: scalability ka matlab hai zaroorat par mazeed resources jorna. Misal: Eid ya 14 August sale par online store ka traffic bohat barhta hai aur woh mazeed servers jor leta hai taake website sust ya band na ho. Elasticity aik qadam aage hai: system demand ke mutabiq resources khud adjust karta hai, traffic barhne par servers jorta aur sale ke baad kam kar deta hai, taake faltu resources ka paisa na lage.

3. On-demand access: lambay setup ke baghair jab chahein computing resources istemal karna, jaise kunwan khodne ke bajaye tap kholna. Misal: student ko school project ke liye achanak extra storage chahiye to woh foran cloud provider se kiraye par le kar istemal shuru kar deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Cloud computing is like having a powerful computer that you can access over the internet

blocks.prompt:
4 A college has three needs: renting virtual servers on which its staff install their own operating system and software, giving student developers a ready environment to build and deploy an app, and giving every teacher email and online documents. Which type of cloud service suits each need? Explain each type with the book's examples. (8 marks)
(Aik college ki teen zaroorat hain: virtual servers kiraye par lena jin par staff apna operating system aur software lagaye, student developers ko app banane aur deploy karne ka tayyar mahol dena, aur har teacher ko email aur online documents dena. Har zaroorat ke liye kaun si cloud service munasib hai? Har qisam ko kitab ki misalon ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Cloud services teen bari qismon (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) mein hain; har aik control, lachak aur intizam ke mukhtalif darje deti hai.

1. Virtual servers kiraye par: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS). IaaS servers, storage aur networking jaisa bunyadi infrastructure pay-as-you-go par deta hai. Users operating systems, applications aur storage control karte hain magar neeche wala physical infrastructure nahi, is liye staff apna operating system aur software laga sakta hai. Misalein: AWS virtual servers kiraye par deta hai; Microsoft Azure aur Google Compute Engine bhi IaaS providers hain.

2. App banane aur deploy karne ka mahol: Platform as a Service (PaaS). PaaS cloud mein mukammal development aur deployment mahol deta hai: infrastructure, middleware, development tools aur management services. Developers hardware aur software layers sambhale baghair coding aur deploy par tawajjuh dete hain. Misalein: Google App Engine, Microsoft Azure App Services aur Heroku.

3. Email aur online documents: Software as a Service (SaaS). SaaS provider ki host aur manage ki hui applications deta hai; users sirf subscribe kar ke internet par istemal karte hain. Is mein hardware sambhalna ya software update karna nahi parta. Misalein: Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Docs, Google Drive), Microsoft Office 365 aur Salesforce.

book_ref.quote: There are different types of cloud services that cater to various needs

User OS, applications aur storage control karta hai
App banane aur deploy karne ka tayyar mahol
Infrastructure, middleware aur development tools milte hain
Teachers ke liye email aur online documents
Tayyar software subscription se internet par

blocks.prompt:
5 Suggest a suitable cloud deployment model for each case and justify it from the book: a large bank holding sensitive customer data; a company that needs everyday operations cheaply but must keep critical data secure during busy periods; a company that cannot afford to stop if one cloud provider has problems; a small business that wants low-cost computing resources without managing hardware. (8 marks)
(Har soorat ke liye munasib cloud deployment model tajweez karein aur kitab se wajah dein: hassas customer data wala bara bank; company jise rozana kaam sasta chahiye magar masroof waqt mein ahem data mehfooz rakhna hai; company jo aik provider ke masle par ruk nahi sakti; chhota business jo hardware sambhale baghair sasta computing chahta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Cloud deployment models batate hain ke cloud services kaise muhayya aur istemal hoti hain; har model control, security aur lachak ke mukhtalif darje deta hai.

1. Bara bank: Private cloud. Private cloud sirf aik idara istemal karta hai aur share nahi hota; yeh bank ke apne data centers ya third-party ke paas host ho sakta hai magar rasai sirf bank ki hoti hai. Private cloud zyada mehfooz magar mehnga hai, jo hassas data ke liye munasib hai.

2. Rozana kaam aur mehfooz ahem data: Hybrid cloud. Hybrid cloud public aur private cloud ko milata hai aur in ke darmiyan data aur applications share hoti hain. Company rozana kaam public cloud par aur hassas data private cloud par rakhti hai; masroof waqt mein kam hassas data aur applications public cloud par bhejti hai aur ahem data private cloud mein rehta hai. Hybrid cloud lachak aur control deta hai.

3. Aik provider ke masle par na rukna: Multi-cloud. Is mein mukhtalif providers ki services hoti hain (jaise analytics ke liye Google Cloud Platform, enterprise apps ke liye Azure, backup aur disaster recovery ke liye AWS). Aik provider par inhisar khatam hota hai; aik mein masla ho to baqi kaam aate hain. Multi-cloud resilience deta hai.

4. Kam kharch wala chhota business: Public cloud. Public cloud internet par kai idaron mein share hota hai aur AWS jaisa third-party provider ise manage karta hai; har size ke business physical hardware sambhale baghair ise istemal karte hain. Public cloud sasta magar kam mehfooz hai.

book_ref.quote: while keeping critical data secure in the private cloud

rows: Sasta rozana kaam + mehfooz ahem data

blocks.prompt:
6 Cloud computing has revolutionized how data is managed, processed and stored. (i) How does the cloud help organizations? (ii) Explain three applications of cloud computing with examples. (8 marks)
(Cloud computing ne data sambhalne, process karne aur rakhne ka tareeqa badal diya hai. (i) Cloud idaron ki kaise madad karta hai? (ii) Cloud computing ke teen istemal misalon ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Cloud computing ke istemal mukhtalif shobon mein phaile hain aur scalable aur sasta hal dete hain jo karkardagi aur jiddat barhate hain. Yeh websites host karne, applications chalane, data storage aur mil kar kaam karne mein madad deta hai. Cloud ki madad se idare kaam hamwar, IT kharch kam aur badalti zarooraton ka jaldi jawab de sakte hain.

(ii) 1. Data storage: cloud storage data ko local devices ke bajaye door ke servers par rakhti hai, taake kahin se bhi mile aur share ho. Misal: Google Drive aur Dropbox files online rakhne aur share karne dete hain; business cloud mein backup rakhte hain taake local hardware kharabi se data mehfooz rahe.

2. Web hosting aur content delivery: cloud websites host karne aur duniya bhar ke users tak content pohanchane ka infrastructure deta hai. Misal: AWS aur Microsoft Azure web hosting dete hain; Cloudflare jaise CDNs content ko users ke qareeb servers par cache kar ke tez pohanchate hain.

3. Machine learning aur AI: cloud ML models aur AI applications banane aur chalane ke taqatwar tools deta hai. Misal: Google Cloud AI aur AWS SageMaker ML models banane, train aur deploy karne ke platforms hain, taake bare local computers ke baghair AI hal ban sakein.

book_ref.quote: Its diverse applications span various sectors, offering scalable and cost-effective solutions

blocks.prompt:
7 Cloud computing brings implications that must be considered. Explain the four implications given in the book: data security; scalability and resource management; cost considerations; compliance and regulatory issues. (8 marks)
(Cloud computing ke kuch asraat hain jin par ghaur zaroori hai. Kitab ke diye gaye chaar asraat samjhayein: data security; scalability aur resource management; kharch; compliance aur qanooni masail.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Data security: security bara masla hai kyunke hassas data door ke servers par rakhne se data breach aur data zaya hone ka khatra hai. Challenges: providers mazboot hifazati iqdamat karte hain magar users ko bhi apna data bachana hai; data breach, ghair mutalliqa rasai aur data ka zaya hona ho sakta hai. Iqdamat: encryption aur mazboot authentication istemal karein aur security policies ka baqaida jaiza lein; providers bhi tools dete hain.

2. Scalability aur resource management: resources demand ke mutabiq badle ja sakte hain; cloud services khud scale up ya down karti hain, jaise rush ke waqt servers jorna aur demand kam hone par ghatana. Achhi resource management (istemal par nazar aur performance behtar karna) faltu kharch se bachne aur behtareen performance ke liye zaroori hai.

3. Kharch: cloud sasta ho sakta hai magar ehtiyat se maali intizam chahiye, kyunke jitna istemal utna paisa, aur nigrani na ho to kharch jaldi barhta hai. Is ke liye istemal aur kharch baqaida dekhein, resources sahi baantein aur munasib pricing plans lein.

4. Compliance aur qanooni masail: idaron ko yaqeeni banana hai ke un ka cloud istemal qanooni aur regulatory taqazon ke mutabiq ho, jo ilaqe aur industry ke saath badalte hain. Data privacy, security aur industry ke standards ke qawaneen ki pabandi zaroori hai; providers is ke liye tools aur features dete hain.

book_ref.quote: While cloud computing offers numerous benefits, it also brings various implications

blocks.prompt:
8 Blockchain can be pictured as a shared digital notebook. (i) Define blockchain and describe the notebook picture. (ii) Explain its three special features: transparency, security and decentralization. (8 marks)
(Blockchain ko aik mushtarka digital notebook samjha ja sakta hai. (i) Blockchain ki definition likhein aur notebook wali misal bayan karein. (ii) Is ki teen khaas khoobiyan samjhayein: transparency, security aur decentralization.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Blockchain maloomat share karne aur un ka hisaab rakhne ka mehfooz aur shaffaf tareeqa hai jis mein kisi aik shakhs ya company par bharosa zaroori nahi; yeh distributed ledger system ke zariye mehfooz aur shaffaf transactions deta hai.
Notebook ki misal: doston ka group hisaab rakhta hai ke kis ne kis ko paisa dena hai. Aik shakhs ke kaghaz ke bajaye sab aisi notebook mein likhte hain jis ki copy sab ke paas hai. Jab bhi koi tabdeeli ho, jaise qarz wapas karna, woh sab notebooks mein aik saath likhi jati hai. Yahi digital notebook blockchain hai (Figure 6.2).

(ii) 1. Transparency (shaffafiyat): group ka har fard notebook mein likha dekh sakta hai, is liye doosron ki nazar mein aaye baghair dhoka ya tabdeeli mushkil hai.

2. Security: notebook mein likhi cheez ko mitana ya badalna taqreeban na-mumkin hai, kyunke cryptography (khufia code ka ilm) naam ka khaas math maloomat ko apni jagah lock kar deta hai.

3. Decentralization: notebook ka koi aik shakhs ya computer incharge nahi. Sab ke paas barabar copy hai aur tabdeeli tab hoti hai jab aksariyat razi ho, is liye yeh munsifana aur qabil-e-bharosa hai.

book_ref.quote: In simple terms, blockchain is a secure and transparent way for people to share and keep track of information

blocks.prompt:
9 Blockchain technology is built on core principles that ensure its functionality and security. Explain decentralization, immutability and consensus mechanisms, naming two consensus mechanisms. (8 marks)
(Blockchain technology kuch bunyadi usoolon par khari hai jo is ka kaam aur hifazat yaqeeni banate hain. Decentralization, immutability aur consensus mechanisms samjhayein aur do consensus mechanisms ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Decentralization: roayati databases ke baraks jinhein markazi idara chalata hai, blockchain ko computers (nodes) ka network mil kar chalata hai jo transactions ki tasdeeq aur record karta hai. Is se single point of failure ka khatra kam aur security zyada hoti hai.

2. Immutability (na badalna): jab block blockchain mein jur jaye to use badla ya mitaya nahi ja sakta. Is se transactions ki tareekh mustaqil aur cher-chhaar se mehfooz rehti hai aur tamam transactions ka qabil-e-aitbar record milta hai.

3. Consensus mechanisms: blockchain networks naya block jorne se pehle transactions ke sahi hone par ittefaq ke liye consensus mechanisms istemal karte hain. Network ki kaafi aksariyat ka ittefaq chahiye, har node ka nahi: Proof of Work mein computing power ki aksariyat aur Proof of Stake mein stake ki aksariyat (aksar do tihai) faisla karti hai; kuch nodes offline ya bad-diyanat hon tab bhi block jur jata hai.
Do aam consensus mechanisms: Proof of Work (PoW) aur Proof of Stake (PoS).

book_ref.quote: Blockchain technology is built on several core principles that ensure its functionality and security

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein chhapa hai ke tamam nodes ka mutafiq (unanimous) faisla zaroori hai; yeh ghalat hai (Book correction). Jawab mein sirf 'kaafi aksariyat' likhein, 'tamam nodes' nahi.

blocks.prompt:
10 A blockchain system is made of key components and runs on a peer-to-peer network. (i) Explain the components: node, ledger, block, transaction and blockchain protocol. (ii) What is a peer-to-peer network? Explain it with the book's file-sharing example. (8 marks)
(Blockchain system kuch ahem hisson se bana hai aur peer-to-peer network par chalta hai. (i) Yeh hisse samjhayein: node, ledger, block, transaction aur blockchain protocol. (ii) Peer-to-peer network kya hai? Kitab ki file-sharing misal se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) 1. Node: woh computer jo blockchain network mein hissa leta hai. Har node blockchain ki copy rakhta aur transactions aur blocks ki tasdeeq mein madad karta hai.
2. Ledger: blockchain par hone wali tamam transactions ka digital record. Yeh tamam nodes mein phaila hota hai, is liye network mein sab ke paas aik jaisi maloomat hoti hai.
3. Block: aik saath bandhi hui transactions ka majmooa. Har block mein unique pehchan (hash), pichhle block ka hawala (parent hash) aur transactions ki list hoti hai.
4. Transaction: blockchain ka aik akela indiraj; yeh participants ke darmiyan assets ya information ki muntaqili hai.
5. Blockchain protocol: transactions ki tasdeeq, blocks jorne aur consensus ke qawaid aur tareeqe tay karta hai; network ki darustgi aur hifazat yaqeeni banata hai.

(ii) Peer-to-peer (P2P) network aisa nizam hai jis mein computers (nodes) markazi server ke baghair seedha aapas mein raabta aur resources share karte hain. Har node client aur server dono ka kaam kar sakta hai, is se network mazboot aur decentralized banta hai.
Misal: file-sharing network mein users aik markazi server ke bajaye aik doosre ke computers se seedha files download karte hain. Yeh tez aur behtar hai kyunke kai users file ke hisse aik saath share karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Several key components make up a blockchain system

blocks.prompt:
11 Blockchain has a wide range of applications beyond cryptocurrency. Explain four use cases of blockchain technology given in the book. (8 marks)
(Blockchain ke cryptocurrency ke ilawa bhi bohat istemal hain. Kitab mein diye gaye blockchain ke chaar istemal samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Cryptocurrencies: Bitcoin aur Ethereum jaisi cryptocurrencies ki bunyadi technology blockchain hai. Yeh bicholon ke baghair mehfooz aur decentralized digital len-den mumkin banata hai.

2. Supply chain management: blockchain supply chain mein maal ki naqal-o-harkat track aur tasdeeq karta hai. Yeh shaffafiyat dhoka rokti, ghaltiyan kam karti aur products ki asliyat yaqeeni banati hai.

3. Healthcare: blockchain mareezon ke records mehfooz rakhta, medical data sambhalta aur yaqeeni banata hai ke sirf ijazat wale log hassas maloomat dekh sakein.

4. Voting systems: blockchain se mehfooz aur shaffaf voting nizam bante hain jin mein votes sahi record aur shumar hote hain aur dhandli ka khatra kam hota hai.

Blockchain ko aksar aise digital ledger se tashbeeh di jati hai jise network mein sab dekhte aur mante hain; aik dafa safha jur jaye to badal nahi sakta, is liye sab ke paas aik jaisa record hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
12 Cryptocurrencies and smart contracts have changed digital finance. (i) Explain the role of cryptocurrencies in the digital economy. (ii) What are smart contracts? Explain them with the book's insurance example, and give their benefits and challenges. (8 marks)
(Cryptocurrencies aur smart contracts ne digital finance badal diya hai. (i) Digital maeeshat mein cryptocurrencies ka kirdar samjhayein. (ii) Smart contracts kya hain? Kitab ki insurance misal se samjhayein aur in ke faide aur challenges likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Cryptocurrencies ka kirdar: cryptocurrencies aisi digital currencies hain jo roayati banks ke baghair kaam karti hain aur duniya bhar mein logon ke darmiyan seedhi len-den karwati hain. Yeh paisa badalne ka mehfooz aur decentralized tareeqa hain: bank ke paise ke baraks yeh blockchain se len-den ko mehfooz aur shaffaf rakhti hain, aisa record jo badal na sake, bicholon ke baghair. Bitcoin aur Ethereum jaisi cryptocurrencies se sarhadon ke paar bhi paisa tez aur sasta bheja ja sakta hai aur banks se mehroom log aalami maeeshat mein hissa le sakte hain. Len-den cryptography se mehfooz hota hai.

(ii) Smart contracts aise digital muahide hain jo khaas sharait poori hone par apni likhi hui sharait khud poori kar dete hain. Yeh blockchain par chalte hain, bicholon ki zaroorat khatam karte aur ghalti aur dhoke ka khatra kam karte hain. Ethereum jaise platforms par developers smart contracts se decentralized applications (DApps) banate hain; yeh finance, supply chain, real estate aur insurance mein istemal hote hain.
Misal: insurance smart contract pehle se tay sharton ke mutabiq flight late hone par khud payment kar deta hai.
Faide: shaffafiyat, kyunke sab fareeq sharait dekh sakte hain; security, kyunke contract ka amal blockchain yaqeeni banata hai.
Challenges: be-ghalti code ki zaroorat, aur in contracts ke jhagre hal karne ke liye qanooni nizam.

book_ref.quote: These technologies together provide secure, transparent, and efficient ways to handle financial transactions and agreements

blocks.prompt:
13 Blockchain changes how products and certificates are verified. (i) Explain how blockchain tracks the origin of a product through the supply chain (Figure 6.3). (ii) Compare manual verification of academic certificates with blockchain-based verification. (8 marks)
(Blockchain products aur certificates ki tasdeeq ka tareeqa badal deta hai. (i) Samjhayein ke blockchain supply chain mein product ke manba ka peecha kaise karta hai (Figure 6.3). (ii) Academic certificates ki manual tasdeeq aur blockchain wali tasdeeq ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Blockchain supply chain mein products ke manba aur safar ka peecha karne ka shaffaf aur mehfooz tareeqa deta hai. Har transaction decentralized ledger par likhi jati hai, is liye raw material supplier se aakhri customer tak har qadam ka peecha ho sakta hai aur woh badal nahi sakta.
Figure 6.3 (chocolate ka manba) mein yeh fareeq hain: suppliers, manufacturers, fabricators, intermediaries, retailers aur customers. Jab supplier manufacturer ko raw material deta hai to record ban kar blockchain mein jurta hai. Yeh har marhale par hota hai; fabricator, intermediary aur retailer sab shaffaf aur qabil-e-tasdeeq tareekh mein izafa karte hain. Aakhir mein customer yeh data dekh kar product ka manba aur us ka mayaar tasdeeq karta hai.
Is traceability se products ki asliyat ki tasdeeq, quality aur kisi masle ke manba ka pata chalta hai.

(ii) Roayati tareeqe mein jaari karne wale idare ko darkhwast di jati hai jo haath se tasdeeq karta hai. Blockchain mein jaari karne wala idara (jaise BISE) certificate ki tafseel decentralized ledger par likhta hai aur koi bhi blockchain dekh kar tasdeeq kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: In Figure 6.3, the connections between different entities in a supply chain are illustrated

Jaari karne wala idara tafseel decentralized ledger par likhta hai
Jaldi: koi bhi blockchain dekh sakta hai
Record na badalne wala aur shaffaf, is liye durust

blocks.prompt:
14 Data security in blockchain can be understood through the example of sending a secure letter. Define data security in blockchain and explain its four techniques using this example. (8 marks)
(Blockchain mein data security ko mehfooz khat bhejne ki misal se samjha ja sakta hai. Blockchain mein data security ki definition likhein aur is misal se is ke chaar tareeqe samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: blockchain mein data security yaqeeni banati hai ke blockchain mein rakhi maloomat ghair mutalliqa rasai, cher-chhaar ya zaya hone se mehfooz rahe. Misal mein aap dost ko ahem maloomat wala khat aise bhejna chahte hain ke raste mein koi aur na parh sake na badal sake.

1. Khat seal karna (Encryption): aap khat aise khaas lifafe mein rakhte hain jo sirf dost khol sake. Blockchain mein encryption data ko aise code mein badalti hai jo sirf asal wusool karne wala (ya sahi key wala) samajh sake (Figure 6.5). Encryption data bachati hai taake sirf ijazat wale parh sakein.

2. Khat par dastakhat (Digital signature): aap lifafe par apna khaas dastakhat karte hain jo dost pehchanta hai, taake use yaqeen ho ke khat aap ka hai aur badla nahi gaya. Digital signature yaqeeni banata hai ke data asli zariye se aaya aur chheda nahi gaya.

3. Bharosemand nizam se bhejna (Blockchain network): aap aisi mehfooz delivery service istemal karte hain jis mein har qadam record hota hai; rasta badalne ya khat chherne ki koshish pakri aur radd ho jati hai. Blockchain mein har data block mein record hota hai aur us mein tabdeeli network fauran dekh leta hai.

4. Khat ki kai copies (Decentralization): aap copies mukhtalif bharosemand services se kai jagah bhejte hain; aik gum ho to baqi pohanch jati hain. Blockchain mein data kai computers (nodes) par hota hai; aik kharab ho bhi jaye to data mehfooz rehta hai aur hackers ke liye hamla ya tabdeeli bohat mushkil hai.

In tareeqon ko mila kar blockchain data rakhne aur bhejne ka bohat mehfooz tareeqa deta hai.

book_ref.quote: By combining these techniques, blockchain provides a very secure way to store and transfer data

rows: Khat ko khaas lifafe mein seal karna
Har qadam record karne wali bharosemand delivery
